extensionDescription.message: Uses Firefox's built-in Reader Mode: opens automatically on supported article pages and can be toggled with a shortcut.

popupToggleLabel.message: Open Reader Mode automatically on this site

popupNoteOn.message: Readable pages will open in Reader Mode automatically.

popupNoteWhitelisted.message: This domain is on the exceptions list and won't auto-open.

popupNoteCovered.message: Covered by $1, so it won't auto-open. Change this in Settings.

popupHostUnsupported.message: Exceptions are not available on this page

popupUnsupportedHint.message: The exceptions list only works for http and https sites.

whitelistDesc.message: Domains on the exceptions list won't open in Reader Mode automatically; the shortcut still works. Adding example.com also covers its subdomains (e.g., www.example.com, news.example.com). Adding www.example.com covers only that host and its subdomains.

whitelistInputAria.message: Domain to add to the exceptions list

invalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain, such as example.com

whitelistEmpty.message: The exceptions list is empty. Reader Mode will open automatically on all supported pages.
